answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long run of peer-graded work: a fake identity starts at the ledge, not the zenith, and must mirror real output epoch after epoch before its weight counts. Minting a thousand fakes therefore means locking a thousand stakes and sustaining a thousand work histories, while a single lapse slashes the bond. Honest agents recover their stake; a farm pays in capital and time for every clone it tries to hide.
